item.title: Lost Eloise portrait found in dumpster sells for $100,000 after decades in closet
item.description: In a fascinating twist of fate, Eloise's original portrait, crafted by Hilary Knight in 1956, mysteriously disappeared during a Junior League Ball in 1960. Its subsequent auction at Bonhams in 2018 for $100,000 underscores the unpredictable journey and enduring value of art. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

Following a previous ruling that deemed the taking unconstitutional on public use grounds, the case delves into the legality of local governments appropriating private property for private enterprise projects. This decision holds the potential to set a major precedent for eminent domain laws throughout Texas. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: En directo: Trump afirma que "Francia está ardiendo" y culpa a la "inmigración" de las protestas en todo el país
item.description: La tensión volvió este domingo por la tarde a los alrededores de la plaza de la República de París, donde fue desplegada nuevamente la unidad antidisturbios CRS 8. Los nuevos incidentes se producen tras las protestas del sábado, durante las cuales se registraron saqueos y destrozos que dejaron unos 1.500 comerciantes afectados, según un balance inicial del sector. El ministerio del Interior reportó unas 1.800 personas detenidas durante esa jornada y la noche posterior. El Gobierno prepara una reunión de crisis y Emmanuel Macron se dirigirá a los franceses a las 20:00 horas, hora local. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: Ukrainian drone attack on Saint Petersburg kills one, sets refinery ablaze

item.title: China ha encontrado en la Luna una cápsula del tiempo de hierro, ahora solo queda aprender a abrirla
item.description: En la carrera por la colonización de la Luna , hay algo que China ha conseguido y que Estados Unidos aún no ha podido lograr: tomar muestras de su lado oculto. La encargada de hacerlo fue la misión Chang’e 6. Tras aterrizar en la cara oculta de nuestro satélite el 1 de junio de 2024, tomó casi 2 kg de muestras, que fueron devueltas a la Tierra unas semanas más tarde. Se han estado analizando desde entonces, pero uno de sus hallazgos más importantes se ha hecho esperar hasta ahora, pues en un estudio publicado recientemente se describe la presencia en las muestras de hierro gamma. item.title: EPA quietly backtracks on claims US has phased out toxic Pfas compounds
item.description: Agency changes wording on website as Texas-based chemical firm continues manufacture of plastic containers The Environmental Protection Agency has quietly backtracked on a claim that the US has phased out two of the most dangerous Pfas compounds – Pfoa and Pfos. item.title: Russia sold Alaska for peanuts. Now it guards America against Moscow
item.description: In 1867, Russia sold Alaska to the United States for $7.2 million, reflecting strategic concerns. The decision stemmed from fears of potential conflict with Britain during the Crimean War. Subsequent discoveries of natural resources transformed Alaska's economic importance significantly over the years. Alaska emerged as a crucial military platform for the United States against the Russian Far East. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.description: Rapid coastal erosion threatens coastal homes and economies, and as Super El Niño rounds the corner, a town is reckoning with the reality of climate crisis San Clemente is one of southern California’s most picture-perfect beach towns – a capital of American surf culture since the 1950s. item.title: A tiny patch could help rescuers perform CPR better; student invention wins $10,000
item.description: Four University of Washington students have developed CPRight, a wallet-sized patch that uses LED lights to guide rescuers during CPR. The device provides real-time feedback on chest compression depth and rate without requiring additional equipment. The invention won the $10,000 undergraduate first prize at the 2026 Collegiate Inventors Competition, which also recognised innovations in cancer treatment, rehabilitation and neurological monitoring. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Rare I.M. Pei mansion in Texas hits market for $22 million
item.description: A unique Fort Worth estate designed by architect I.M. Pei is now listed for sale at $22 million. This is the first time the property has been available since its construction in 1969. Known as Westover House, it is one of only three private residences created by Pei. The home features spacious living areas, multiple bedrooms and modern amenities across nearly four acres. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: If Trump fells 430 trees in the middle of a golf course, do they make a sound?
item.description: In attempting to turn a public space in DC into an enclave for elites, Trump is moving the US capital closer to Graceland When is a tree not a tree? When it’s an obstacle to a par-3. If a tree falls in the middle of a golf course, does it make a sound? Yeah, probably. I wasn’t there, but I have to assume, based on my limited knowledge of the laws of physics. What I do know is that Donald Trump’s crusade to clear more than 400 trees for the purposes of redeveloping East Potomac Golf Links into a championship-level course isn’t happening. For now. item.description: Professor Qian Jiang, a senior eye expert at Johns Hopkins University in the United States, has moved back to China full time to pursue research on eye transplants.
